items.text: In a disposable checkout with a fake GitHub client, a real close commit for a completed milestone plan closes only its named issues and verifies zero open issues remotely. Exercise already-closed issues, a repeated reference, and a paginated milestone. Ordinary commits and standalone plans make no GitHub calls.

A wrong milestone, unfinished node, unexpected open issue, failed GitHub request or nonzero final open count blocks local close with a useful diagnostic. A retry handles partially completed remote updates. Run the hook regression alongside the simulator close test.
